title: What sign should the product have?
text: One factor is negative and one is positive, so the signs are opposite. A common mistake is to multiply the absolute values and leave the product positive. What sign does $$-6 \times 4$$ have?

title: Multiply the absolute values
text: Ignore the signs for a moment. What is $$6 \times 4$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$-6 \times 4 = -24$$. Common mistake: writing $$24$$ because 'times makes things bigger.' Size and sign are separate: the absolute value is 24, and opposite signs make it negative. General rule: opposite signs give a negative product; same signs give a positive product.
